'''Law''' was a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Clone trooper lieutenant]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Law commanded a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that accompanied [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[B'ink Utrila]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Rennax Omani]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draay 2]], on a mission to prevent the ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] the [[Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger]] from falling into the hands of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The party eventually located the [[Jedi Temple (Draay 2)|Jedi Temple]] in which the artifact was housed, but after facing off against a [[Stone guardian/Legends|guard droid]] and a horde of [[sarl]] creatures, they failed at recovering the artifact because the gauntlet was too strong in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to touch it. Law and the rest of the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] made camp within the [[temple]] while they pondered their next move, but they were attacked by a group of [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], who sought to seize the artifact for themselves. The clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Glitch]] defeated the Mandalorians by activating a defense mechanism that caused the temple to collapse. In the aftermath of the building's destruction, Law and the other clones believed Glitch to be [[Death/Legends|dead]] and they commended their comrade's efforts.<ref name="Defenders of TLT" />
